$comment: State names, two-letter abbreviations, and multi-state regions, lifted verbatim from
signals.py. Values are the canonical Title-cased display labels.
ABBREVIATIONS ARE MATCHED CASE-SENSITIVELY and that is load-bearing: a case-insensitive
'up'/'mp' collides with shop-floor phrasing like 'set up' / 'setup' and would corrupt the
profile. 'UP' written in caps is a state. This is why `abbreviations` carries flags ""
Regions are WHOLE PHRASES only — 'south' and 'india' on their own say nothing
('south side me rehta hu', 'made in India'), so neither is a cue.
